title: Central bank policy rates, monthly, end of period
provider: Bank for International Settlements, BIS Data Portal (dataset WS_CBPOL), SDMX API v2
licence: Use unrestricted with the BIS cited as the source, not implying endorsement and without additional charge (BIS Data Portal terms)
citation: Bank for International Settlements, Central bank policy rates (WS_CBPOL), https://data.bis.org
format: CSV: REF_AREA (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; XM the euro area), TIME_PERIOD (YYYY-MM), OBS_VALUE the policy rate in per cent a year at the end of the month
coverage: about forty central banks, monthly, most since the 1990s

major.description: The euro area and the twenty economies of the ECB profile, monthly, 2015 to mid-2026
